data.name: Meta_Description
data.value: Privacy Policy for TimeVic, a time tracking and income tracking app for freelancers and small teams.

data.name: Intro_1
data.value: TimeVic (“TimeVic”, “we”, “our”, or “us”) provides a time tracking and work management service that helps freelancers, developers, and small teams track work hours, organize clients and projects, record payments, and understand earned, paid, and outstanding income.

data.name: Intro_2
data.value: This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, how we protect it, and what choices you have.

data.name: InformationWeCollect_Text
data.value: We collect information that you provide directly, information generated when you use TimeVic, and limited information from third-party services when you choose to connect them.

data.name: AccountInformation_Text
data.value: When you create or use an account, we may collect:

data.name: AccountInformation_Item_Settings
data.value: Account settings, such as language or preferences

data.name: WorkspaceAndProductivityData_Text
data.value: When you use TimeVic, you may create or store information such as:

data.name: WorkspaceAndProductivityData_Item_PaymentRecords
data.value: Payment records, such as paid/unpaid status, payment dates, amounts, and notes

data.name: WorkspaceAndProductivityData_Item_NotesMessages
data.value: Workspace notes or messages, if these features are used

data.name: WorkspaceAndProductivityData_CoreUse
data.value: This information is used to provide the core TimeVic functionality: tracking time, calculating earned amounts, showing paid and unpaid balances, and generating reports.

data.name: GoogleAccountData_Text
data.value: If you sign in with Google, TimeVic may receive basic Google account information, depending on the permissions you approve, such as:

data.name: GoogleAccountData_Use
data.value: We use this information only to authenticate you, create or access your TimeVic account, and display your profile information inside the application.

data.name: GoogleAccountData_NoAdsNoSale
data.value: TimeVic does not use Google user data for advertising. TimeVic does not sell Google user data.

data.name: GoogleAccountData_LimitedUse
data.value: TimeVic’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

data.name: TechnicalAndUsageData_Text
data.value: We may collect technical information necessary to operate, secure, and improve the service, such as:

data.name: TechnicalAndUsageData_Item_ApproximateLocation
data.value: Approximate location derived from IP address

data.name: TechnicalAndUsageData_Use
data.value: We use this information for security, troubleshooting, analytics, abuse prevention, and service improvement.

data.name: HowWeUseInformation_Item_Calculate
data.value: Calculate earned, paid, and outstanding amounts

data.name: HowWeUseInformation_Item_Detect
data.value: Detect, prevent, and investigate abuse, fraud, or security issues

data.name: HowWeShareInformation_NoSale
data.value: We do not sell personal information.

data.name: HowWeShareInformation_Text
data.value: We may share information only in the following limited cases:

data.name: ServiceProviders_Text
data.value: We may use trusted third-party service providers to host, operate, secure, or monitor TimeVic. These providers may process information only as needed to provide services to us.

data.name: ThirdPartyIntegrations_Text
data.value: If you connect TimeVic to a third-party service, such as Google authentication or another integration, information may be exchanged with that service only as necessary to provide the integration you requested.

data.name: ThirdPartyIntegrations_Policies
data.value: Third-party services have their own privacy policies and terms.

data.name: LegalAndSafetyRequirements_Text
data.value: We may disclose information if required to:

data.name: LegalAndSafetyRequirements_Item_Protect
data.value: Protect the rights, safety, and property of TimeVic, users, or others

data.name: LegalAndSafetyRequirements_Item_Investigate
data.value: Investigate abuse, fraud, or security incidents

data.name: DataStorageAndSecurity_Text
data.value: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect user data from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or alteration.

data.name: DataStorageAndSecurity_NoGuarantee
data.value: No online service can guarantee absolute security, but we work to protect user data using appropriate safeguards.

data.name: DataRetention_Text
data.value: We retain account and workspace data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the service.

data.name: DataRetention_LongRetentionIntro
data.value: We may retain certain information for a longer period when necessary to:

data.name: DataRetention_Deletion
data.value: If you request account deletion, we will delete or anonymize personal information where reasonably possible, unless retention is required by law, security, backup, or legitimate business purposes.

data.name: UserChoicesAndRights_Text
data.value: Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

data.name: UserChoicesAndRights_Item_Object
data.value: Object to or restrict certain processing

data.name: UserChoicesAndRights_Item_Copy
data.value: Request a copy of your data

data.name: UserChoicesAndRights_Item_Withdraw
data.value: Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent

data.name: UserChoicesAndRights_Request
data.value: To make a request, contact us at:

data.name: Cookies_Text
data.value: TimeVic may use cookies or similar technologies to:

data.name: Cookies_BrowserSettings
data.value: You can control cookies through your browser settings, but disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the service.

data.name: ChildrensPrivacy_Text
data.value: TimeVic is not intended for children under 13 years old. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe that a child has provided us personal information, contact us and we will take appropriate action.

data.name: InternationalUsers_Text
data.value: TimeVic may process and store information in countries other than your country of residence. By using TimeVic, you understand that your information may be processed where our systems, service providers, or infrastructure are located.

data.name: Changes_Text
data.value: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will update the “Last updated” date and, where appropriate, provide additional notice.

data.name: Changes_ContinuedUse
data.value: Your continued use of TimeVic after changes become effective means you accept the updated Privacy Policy.

data.name: ContactUs_Text
data.value: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how TimeVic handles your data, contact us at:
